Overview

Computes all one- and two-electron AO integrals using the McMurchie-Davidson scheme. All returned tensors are torch::kDouble, two-dimensional (or rank-4 is never returned directly — the Coulomb/exchange matrices are already contracted with a density matrix).

Header: include/integrals.hpp Source: src/integrals.cpp

For the mathematical background see McMurchie-Davidson Integral Engine.

One-Electron Integrals

torch::Tensor build_overlap(const BasisSet &bs)
Returns:

Symmetric \(N_b \times N_b\) overlap matrix \(S_{\mu\nu} = \langle\mu|\nu\rangle\).

Key property: \(S = X^{-T} X^{-1}\) where \(X\) is the canonical orthogonalization matrix (see Canonical Orthogonalization).

torch::Tensor build_kinetic(const BasisSet &bs)
Returns:

Symmetric \(N_b \times N_b\) kinetic energy matrix \(T_{\mu\nu} = \langle\mu|-\tfrac{1}{2}\nabla^2|\nu\rangle\).

torch::Tensor build_nuclear(const BasisSet &bs, const Molecule &mol)
Parameters:

  • bs – Basis set.

  • mol – Molecule; atomic charges \(Z_A\) and positions \(\mathbf{R}_A\) enter the nuclear-attraction sum.

Returns:

Symmetric \(N_b \times N_b\) nuclear-attraction matrix

\[V_{\mu\nu} = \sum_A \left\langle\mu\left| \frac{-Z_A}{|\mathbf{r}-\mathbf{R}_A|}\right|\nu\right\rangle.\]

torch::Tensor build_hcore(const BasisSet &bs, const Molecule &mol)

Convenience inline that returns build_kinetic() + build_nuclear():

\[H^{\rm core}_{\mu\nu} = T_{\mu\nu} + V_{\mu\nu}.\]

Defined inline in the header.

Two-Electron Integrals

torch::Tensor build_schwarz(const BasisSet &bs)
Returns:

Symmetric \(N_b \times N_b\) Schwarz bound matrix \(Q_{\mu\nu} = \sqrt{(\mu\nu|\mu\nu)}\).

Used to screen shell quartets and individual basis-function pairs in build_JK(). Call this once before the SCF iteration and pass the result to every build_JK() call.

std::pair<torch::Tensor, torch::Tensor> build_JK(const BasisSet &bs, const torch::Tensor &P, const torch::Tensor &screen, double tol = 1e-10)
Parameters:

  • bs – Basis set.

  • P – AO density matrix \(\mathbf{P}\), shape \([N_b, N_b]\), torch::kDouble.

  • screen – Schwarz matrix from build_schwarz().

  • tol – Schwarz screening threshold (default 1e-10).

Returns:

{J, K} — Coulomb and exchange matrices, both \(N_b \times N_b\).

Computes in a single loop over shell quartets:

\[\begin{split}J_{\mu\nu} &= \sum_{\lambda\sigma} P_{\lambda\sigma}\,(\mu\nu|\lambda\sigma) \\ K_{\mu\nu} &= \sum_{\lambda\sigma} P_{\lambda\sigma}\,(\mu\sigma|\lambda\nu)\end{split}\]

exploiting 8-fold permutational symmetry and Schwarz screening.

Two screening levels are applied:

  1. Shell level: skip entire shell quartet \((\mathbf{a}\mathbf{b}|\mathbf{c}\mathbf{d})\) if \(Q_{ab}^\text{shell} \cdot Q_{cd}^\text{shell} < \varepsilon\).

  2. Function level: within a surviving quartet, skip individual \((\mu\nu|\lambda\sigma)\) if \(|Q_{\mu\nu}| \cdot |Q_{\lambda\sigma}| < \varepsilon\).

The Fock matrix is then assembled by the caller as \(F = H^{\rm core} + J - \tfrac{1}{2}K\) (RHF) or the spin-specific form for UHF.

Internal Functions (implementation details)

The following are in the anonymous namespace of integrals.cpp and not part of the public API, but are documented here for reference.

fill_E(E, alpha, beta, XAB)

Fills the \(9 \times 9 \times 18\) E-coefficient table for one Cartesian direction with exponents \(\alpha\), \(\beta\) and centre separation \(X_{AB} = A - B\) (in Bohr).

Uses horizontal recursion for \(j = 0\) first, then vertical recursion for \(j > 0\).

fill_R(R, p, PC, nmax)

Fills the \(20 \times 20 \times 20 \times 20\) R-integral table \(R^n_{tuv}\) up to order nmax, for exponent p and displacement \(\mathbf{P}-\mathbf{C}\).

The Boys values at each base index are supplied externally via the global Boys vector computed once per shell pair/quartet.

prim_norm(alpha, l)

Returns the normalisation constant for a primitive Gaussian with exponent \(\alpha\) and angular momentum \(\ell\):

\[N = \left(\frac{2\alpha}{\pi}\right)^{3/4} \sqrt{\frac{(4\alpha)^\ell}{(2\ell-1)!!}}\]

Used during basis loading in basis_parser.cpp.
